text.title: RACI AI Assisted Decision Tree
text.summary: Tree mapping observable matrix signals (trigger, roster membership, leaf coverage, A count, anchors, staleness) to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Walk it at every trigger before publish.

decision-tree.root-question: Is `header.trigger` one of kickoff, roster_delta, quarterly_review, and do a WBS spec and a stakeholder register exist?

conclusion.verdict: skip; RACI binds to WBS leaves and roster roles, build those first (see wbs-creation)
refuse; name the trigger from the enum, no 'when needed' refresh

branch.when: trigger_valid == true AND wbs_spec == true AND stakeholder_register == true
branch.question: Is there one row per open WBS leaf and none for summary nodes, with every R / A / C / I value present in the current roster?

conclusion.verdict: repair: add rows for uncovered leaves, drop parent rows
repair: flag orphaned rows, reassign before publish

branch.when: leaf_coverage_complete == true AND summary_node_rows == 0 AND roles_not_in_roster == 0
branch.question: Does every row have exactly one A, no role in two columns, and at least one resolving anchor (charter#, wbs-dict#, stakeholders#)?

conclusion.verdict: repair: rerun assign-A; single A per row, one column per role
hold as proposed; PM confirms or supplies the anchor

branch.question: Is `last_reviewed` within 90 days and are closed leaves removed?

conclusion.verdict: refresh: run the quarterly review, append counts to review_log, then publish
publish RACIMatrix; send each R / A holder their rows and record channel, date and rows in review_log

text.example: trigger=roster_delta, WBS + register present → 14 open leaves, 14 rows, no parent rows, all roles in roster → every row one A, no double columns, anchors resolve → last_reviewed 2026-05-10 (fresh), no closed leaves → publish; backend-lead and security-lead receive their rows in #checkout, recorded in review_log.
